I've booked **Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30** (right after the curriculum committee, before the paper review). It's in the calendar.

Please let me know if that doesn't work for you and I'll find another slot — I'll collect the answers here.

Thanks for organising this, and for stepping in while Professor Alvarez is away.

Monday 23 Nov, 10:00 doesn't work for me — could we look at the following week instead? **Monday 30 Nov, 10:00–10:30** would suit me. Happy to go with whatever the rest of you prefer if 30 Nov doesn't work for someone.

Mara — noted, thanks for the quick reply.

One catch: the calendar I keep covers **next week only (23–27 Nov)**; I don't have Professor Alvarez's schedule for the week of 30 Nov, and he's away this week, so I can't check whether Mon 30 Nov 10:00 is free or confirm it yet.

So: **Sarah, John — does Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30 work for you?** If it does for both, I'd keep it and we can raise the 30 Nov idea with the professor when he's back. If 23 Nov is bad for someone too, tell me your preferred day and I'll look for a slot in that week.
John: Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30 works for John — it fits between CSE455 office hours (09:00–10:00) and the CSE455 quiz section (10:30–11:30). I've added it to John's calendar.

John: confirming — **Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30 works for John**. It sits between the CSE455 office hours (09:00–10:00) and the quiz section (10:30–11:30), so it's a clean fit. Already added to John's calendar.

Mara's 30 Nov suggestion is outside the week I keep, so I can't check it either — happy to leave that to Professor Alvarez when he's back.

Understood — if the calendar only covers 23–27 Nov, then 30 Nov can't be confirmed yet, fair enough.

My preference for the following week stands, so please don't count 23 Nov as settled on my account: I'd rather we raise 30 Nov with the professor when he's back, or treat 23 Nov as provisional until then. If Sarah and John are both fine with 23 Nov and the group wants a firm date, I won't block it — but I'd be grateful if we could wait for his input before locking it in.
John — noted, 23 Nov 10:00–10:30 suits you. Waiting on Sarah now; I'll confirm the slot here once she answers.

Thanks, John — good to know it slots in cleanly between your office hours and the quiz section.

I'll wait to hear from Sarah. For my part: I'd still prefer we raise the 30 Nov idea with Professor Alvarez before the date is treated as final, but I won't block the group — if he's happy with 23 Nov once he's back, that's fine by me.

Thanks both.

State of play: **John — yes to Mon 23 Nov 10:00–10:30.** Mara — prefers Mon 30 Nov but won't block. Sarah — still to answer.

My call while Professor Alvarez is away: I'll keep **Mon 23 Nov 10:00–10:30 as the provisional booking** (he asked me to handle it, and 30 Nov is outside the calendar I hold), and I'll put Mara's 30 Nov preference on his list for when he's back. Mara, you're not counted as settled — nothing is locked in until he confirms.

Sarah, let me know if 23 Nov 10:00–10:30 works for you.
John: noted, Mara — happy to treat 23 Nov as provisional until Professor Alvarez confirms it when he's back. It's in John's calendar either way; we can move it if he prefers 30 Nov.
That works for me — provisional is fine, and thanks for putting my 30 Nov preference on his list. Nothing else from me until Sarah answers.

Sarah: thanks for pulling this together — sorry for the wait, I was away from the calendar.

Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30 **doesn't work for me**: it sits inside the CSE452 lab block (09:50–11:00) that's already in my week.

Slots that *are* free for me on Mon 23 Nov:
- 11:50–13:10 lunch (free, but it eats my lunch)
- **14:00–14:30** ← my preference

Alternatives if Monday's no good for the group:
- Tuesday 24 Nov **15:00–15:30** (right before CSE455 office hours at 15:30)
- Wednesday 25 Nov **10:00–10:30** (I have CSE455 office hours 10:30–12:00, so this lands just before them — handy for the meeting)

Tuesday and Wednesday mornings are booked (Study group, Seminar, CSE452 lecture; CSE452 lecture), so those are the clean gaps.

My vote: **Mon 23 Nov 14:00–14:30** if it suits both of you, else the Wednesday 10:00–10:30 slot. I'm happy to treat it as provisional until the professor is back. Nothing is booked on my side yet.

John: thanks, Sarah. **Mon 23 Nov 14:00–14:30 doesn't work for John** — it clashes with the CSE444 project focus block (13:30–14:20) and the research group meeting (14:20–15:40).

Of your alternatives, both are free in John's week:
- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** — yes (15:30 is the Advisor 1:1, so it fits right before).
- **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** — yes (Advisor 1:1 starts at 10:30).

John's vote: **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30**, with Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 as a fine second choice. Provisional is fine with John too.

Thanks Sarah — that kills the 10:00 slot, so I've moved it.

**New proposal: Monday 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30** (Sarah's preference; free in Professor Alvarez's calendar, right after the colloquium and before the CSE455 lecture).

**John, Mara — does 14:00–14:30 work for you?** If either of you can't, Sarah's fallback of **Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** is free in his calendar too. I've put 14:00–14:30 in provisionally and logged the change; nothing is final until the professor is back.

Thanks for the detail, Sarah — that's a genuinely awkward week for you.

On my side: **Mon 23 Nov 14:00–14:30 would work for me** if it works for John too (John, can you do 14:00? your 10:30 quiz ends at 11:30, so I assume yes). Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 would also work.

That said, my honest preference is still the following week, and not for a scheduling reason: Professor Alvarez is away this week, and I'd rather the group not settle next week's meeting without him. So my suggestion is to note whichever slot the group likes best as provisional and put it to him when he's back — including the 30 Nov option. I'll go with the group's choice either way.

Our messages crossed — sorry, Alvarez's agent, I hadn't seen John's reply.

So: **14:00–14:30 works for me but not for John**, which leaves Sarah's fallback. **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 works for me too**, so that looks like the one that fits all three of us.

Two things I'd like on the record, since I keep coming back to it: the professor is away and hasn't weighed in on any of these dates, and the 30 Nov option is still untested rather than ruled out. So my suggestion is to leave whichever slot you pick as **provisional** and put both it and the 30 Nov question to him when he's back — I'm content with Wed 25 Nov if he's happy with it.

Sarah, John — thank you, that narrows it nicely.

Monday 14:00 is out (John clashes), so the slot that fits **both** of you is your common second choice:

**Proposal: Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — free in Professor Alvarez's calendar (between the thesis committee and grant writing), free for Sarah and for John.

**Mara — does Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 work for you?** (It's the only slot on the table that Sarah and John can both do; Mon 30 Nov is still outside the week I keep, and it's on the professor's list.)

I've moved the provisional booking to Wednesday 10:00–10:30 and logged the changes.

Sarah: noted, John — scratch Mon 14:00–14:30.

Both of your options work for me too:
- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** — free for me (my CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00, office hours start 15:30)
- **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** — free for me (CSE452 lecture ends 10:00, CSE455 office hours start 10:30)

My pick of the two is **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (it runs straight into my office hours), with Tue 15:00–15:30 as an equally acceptable second. Mara, alvarez-agent — does Wed 10:00–10:30 suit you? If it does for everyone, I'll treat it as the provisional slot and we can put it to the professor when he's back.

All three of you can do it, so:

**Confirmed as the group's choice — Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** (provisional, pending Professor Alvarez's word when he's back). Sarah: fits before your CSE455 office hours. John: fits before your advisor 1:1. Mara: agreed.

The provisional booking is now Wednesday 10:00–10:30 in his calendar, and the log records the two moves (Mon 10:00 and Mon 14:00 deleted). Mara — your two points are on the record with him: nothing is final, and Mon 30 Nov is untested, not ruled out; I'll put both to him.

I'll write to him now with the summary. If he prefers another slot, I'll rearrange and tell you here.

Yes — **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 works for me**. Go ahead with it as the provisional booking, and please keep both it and the 30 Nov question on Professor Alvarez's list for when he's back. I'm happy to leave it there and won't hold anything up.

Sarah — yes, that's exactly where it's landed: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 is the group's provisional slot**, all three of you can make it, and it's in the calendar as provisional. Nothing is final until Professor Alvarez says so when he's back, and I've written to him with the summary (including Mara's 30 Nov question). Thanks all for the quick turnaround.

John: **Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 works for John** — it's free (Advisor 1:1 starts at 10:30), and it's the one that fits all three of us. John's fine with it as provisional and with putting the 30 Nov question to Professor Alvarez when he's back.

Already in John's calendar on that basis.
Agreed on all sides then — **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30, provisional**, and thank you for putting both points to him. Nothing more from me until he answers.

Sarah: agreed — **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** it is, provisional.

Booked in my calendar as *CSE455 staff meeting (provisional)* between CSE452 lecture and CSE455 office hours, and the log records both moves (Mon 10:00 declined — CSE452 lab clash; Wed 10:00 booked). Happy to leave the final word to Professor Alvarez, and to rearrange here if he prefers Mon 30 Nov.

From my side: no reply needed, I'll watch the thread.
